text_block_list.text:
One day in the early afternoon. Loves Only 
You's phone started ringing.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Blast-san...? Excuse me for a moment, 
Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Blast-san...? Excuse me for a moment, 
Trainer-chan.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
—I'm so sorry, Loves! The plane wasn't 
able to take off!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
So I don't think I can stream today! Even 
though I promised... I'm really, really 
sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...No, please don't apologize! It's not 
your fault at all, Blast-san!"

It seems Blast Onepiece, who was supposed 
to be a guest on today's stream, won't 
make it back from her away trip in time...
choice_data_list:
…We've already made the announcement, 
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: You're right. ...In that case—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I might have rushed through it a bit, 
but... did you manage to set it up?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Done! Now we can make a remote 
appearance!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes! If you don't mind, could we run a 
quick transmission test?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"How's this—! Can—you—see—clearly—? Hey—! 
Is this stream—working—too—?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. The reception might be a 
bit poor. Could you try moving to a 
different spot?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"We tried everything we could, but 
connection issues are likely to persist. A 
remote appearance might be a bit too 
risky."
choice_data_list: I see... Hmm, what should I do?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ......Mm. I have a wonderful idea♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hii! Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only 
You♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Before we start the stream, I'm so sorry! 
I was planning to do a collab with 
Blast-san today, but—"

When I explained the situation, 
disappointed voices arose. Of course, no 
one blamed me— but I could tell the mood 
in the chat had dampened.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what a shame. There was so much I 
wanted to talk about, too... Buuut?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In its place, look what arrived! ♡ 
Starting the video now!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Heeeeey! Everyone! Are you watchiiiiing?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Sorry I couldn't make it to the stream 
today! Instead, though...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo is gonna give you a whole bunch of 
quizzes! Hope you guys all have fun with 
'em!"

The chat livens up once again. "Boo-chan!" 
"I thought we wouldn't get to see her 
today!" "Thanks for the VTR!" "What's this 
about a quiz!?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
And so, from here on out! We're all gonna 
try answering Blast's trivia questions!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here's Question 1! Da-dum! What 
did Buu eat for dinner tonight?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"What was Boo-chan's favorite food 
again...?" "Melon!" "Carrot cookies!" 
"Carrot cookies makes sense." "Dark horse 
bet on sushi!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Those are some good guesses, 
everyone. Alright, let's keep playing the 
video~

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The correct answer is... carrot cookies! I 
probably ate like fifty of them! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Because someone gave me cookies as a 
present after the race! When given that 
much, there's no way I could hold back!

"‘Yay, correct!’ ‘You really love piggies, 
don't you, Boo-chan!’ The chat lit up once 
again. Watching it, I couldn't help but 
mutter to myself."
choice_data_list:
This stream has turned into something 
everyone can enjoy...!

text_block_list.text:
The next day, getting a bit carried away, 
I told her just how fun yesterday's stream 
had been.
choice_data_list:
Including the preparations, I saw your 
“love.”

Including the preparations, I saw your 
“love.”

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you. But you see, I—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I only did what was natural.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I usually keep things super chill on my 
streams... giving love, getting love, you 
know?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I have to put everything I've 
got into the prep work for our stream, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I won't truly be able to— bring 
joy to everyone.

Moved by Loves Only You's pride, I felt 
once again how deeply captivated I am by 
the way she carries herself, as a fan—
choice_data_list:
It's because you're like that that I want 
to cheer you on.

It's because you're like that that I want 
to root for you.

If there's anything I can do to help, just 
say the word!

text_block_list.text:
Moved by Loves Only You's pride, I felt 
once again how deeply captivated I am by 
the way she carries herself, as a fan—
choice_data_list:
It's because you're like that that I want 
to cheer you on.

It's because you're like that that I want 
to root for you.

If there's anything I can do to help, just 
say the word!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh♡ What's this all of a sudden? 
Flattery won't get you anything, you 
know~?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Still, you're right... Hehehe♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Same to you! Thank you so much for always 
cheering me on. Love you♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Same to you. Thank you for always cheering 
me on. Love you! ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Even if you didn't say it, I'd 
be counting on you anyway♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. To get straight to 
the point... I've been thinking about 
getting a new PC soon...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if someone would carry this 
back to the dorms with me~? Peek, peek♡"
